reason: Same single sense. 'just (now, at the moment)' is the -た途端に 'the moment that' use, and ZH 刚一...就 states it exactly; the proposal only rewords it.
'tropics' and 'tropical zone' are the same word; 熱帯の植物 needs nothing new.
'issue' already covers issuing a passport; 'issuance of documents' narrows the same sense to the sentence's referent.

別の面 = another aspect of a matter, not the face/mask/surface senses the EN line lists; a learner reading 'face, mask, surface' would picture a physical surface. ZH already carries it as 方面 - only EN is missing it.
'sounds' is the same sense; 'noise' is only a stylistic upgrade of the wording.
'factor' is already in the EN line verbatim.
'clothes, garments' vs 'clothing or garments' - identical.
'irritation' already listed; the proposal is the adjectival restatement of it.
'skillful, handy' already covers 手先が器用 (dexterous).
'stinking, smelly' is exactly 'foul-smelling'.
'sound asleep, fast asleep' is the same adverbial sense, reworded.
'via, through' = 'by way of'; 東京経由 needs nothing new.
'fault, defect, weakness' covers 'flaw or shortcoming' completely.
'congestion' is already in the EN line.
実際に = 'in reality/in practice', which the noun gloss 'reality, actual state' supports directly, and ZH 事实上 is already the adverbial reading. Part-of-speech restatement, not a new sense.
女子生徒 is what the sentence supplies; 女子 by itself is 'girl, woman', already glossed. 'female students' describes the sentence's noun phrase, not a sense of the headword.
'notice, notification' is the same sense; 'news' is only a register shift, and ZH already lists 消息.

粗末にする = to treat carelessly / waste, which is a separate dictionary sense from 'crude, rough, plain'. A learner reading 'crude, rough, plain' beside 'You must not waste food' gets nothing usable. ZH 粗糙/简陋 is missing it too.
'sure, no mistake, certain' is exactly the に違いない 'must be' reading.
"one's strong point" is already in the EN line verbatim.
'beautiful person, beauty' covers 'beautiful woman'; only the gender is narrowed by the sentence.
One sense in the dictionaries ('wrong, bad, improper, not allowed'); ZH 不可 is itself the 'must not / not permitted' word. Signage use is the same sense.
'misfortune' is already listed; the proposal restates it as an event.

The EN line is only the 'entirely/completely' (with-negative) sense; まるで〜ようだ 'just like, as if' is the other, and 'quite, entirely, completely' beside 'Her smile is just like the sun' misleads. ZH already has it as 宛如 - the gap is EN-only.
'seeing one off' is already the EN gloss word for word.
EN gives only the 'daze, trance, ecstasy' sense; ゲームに夢中 is 'absorbed in, crazy about', which a learner cannot reach from 'daze' or 'ecstasy'. ZH 沉迷/热衷 already covers it, so this is an EN-side gap.
'money exchange' already covers exchanging bills.
'the aged, old person' = 'elderly person'.
'to get tired of, to lose interest in' is the proposal verbatim.
'someday' already covers いずれまたお会いしましょう.
'anytime' is literally 'at any time'.
'welcome, reception' covers welcoming a new member; 'warmly' adds only tone.
'engineer, technician' = 'technical specialist or engineer'.
'absorption' covers roots absorbing water; the proposal just names the sentence's substances.
'game, match' already covers athletic events at a sports day.
'lover, sweetheart' = 'romantic partner'.
'composition (music)' is the same sense in noun form; 作曲する is the する verb of it.
'publication' covers publishing a book; only the object is added from the sentence.
'superiority, first class' already means high quality.
'not one bit' is already the EN gloss for 少しも + negative.
'manufactured goods, finished goods' = 'manufactured product'; singular vs plural only.

相当な here is the degree sense 'considerable, quite (high)', a separate numbered sense from 'suitable/befitting'. Beside 'suitable, fair' a learner reads 相当なレベル as 'a suitable level', which is a real misreading. ZH 相当 already carries the degree sense; EN does not.
大した病気ではない is the listed 'considerable, great' sense under negation; 'serious' is the same idea in the negative frame.
'house' already covers 宅におります; 'one's own home' adds only the possessive from context.
University 単位 are course credits, which 'unit, denomination' does not reach - a learner reads 'I took all the necessary units'. ZH already lists 学分, so only the EN line is short.

'tour group' is the sentence's referent, not a sense of 団体. (Separately, EN 'organization, association' arguably under-covers the 'group, party' reading that ZH 团体 has, but the proposal as worded is sentence-bound.)
'centre, central' covers the middle of a room.
'core' already covers being the core/central figure of a team.
'to pile up' = 'to accumulate'.
'incident, happening' = 'event'.
EN lists only the person nouns 'helper, assistant'; 手伝いをする is the act, 'help, assistance'. Beside 'I helped with housework' the EN line reads as a person. ZH already has the act sense as 帮忙.
'examination paper, test paper' is the answer sheet; identical sense.
'simultaneous, concurrent' = 'at the same time'.
'company, fellow' already covers 会社の仲間 (colleagues, companions).
'riddle, puzzle' and 'mystery' are the same sense of 謎; unsolved puzzles of a building's history reads fine.
'absorption' is already in the EN line.
'whole year, always' = 'all year round'.
'announcement, publication' covers presenting research results; the proposal is the verb form.
One dictionary sense spanning injustice/impropriety/wrongdoing; 'injustice, unfairness' plus ZH 舞弊 already reads correctly for corporate 不正.
全く + negative is the systematic use of the listed 'entirely'; ZH 完全 does the same work.
'target' already means goal/objective.
'association of ideas' is exactly 'mental association'.
'congress, parliament' covers a city assembly; 'local' comes from 市の in the sentence.
'commemoration, memory' covers 卒業の記念に.
'no smoking' is 'prohibition of smoking'.
'distinction, differentiation' = distinguishing between things.
'army, troops' = 'armed forces, military'.
'calculation, count' already covers calculating change.
'decision, determination' = settling/deciding.
'right, privilege' already covers the right to speak; 'legal or moral' only qualifies it.
'fairness, justice' covers treating students fairly.

'furthermore, again' is the additive/connective sense; 風が更に強くなった is the degree intensifier 'even more, still more', which 'furthermore' does not give ('the wind became furthermore strong'). ZH 更加 already covers it - EN is the gap.
'execution, implementation' = carrying out a plan.
'sisters' = 'female siblings'.
'favourable, doing well' covers a project progressing smoothly.
'just a minute' is already the time reading of 少々.
'government' = 'governing body of a country'.
'but (still), and yet' = 'even so, nevertheless'.
'to be in response to' is already the 'regarding, toward' sense.
'lunch' = 'midday meal'.
'in succession, one by one' = 'one after another'.
'bundle, package' already covers a wrapped parcel.

手を繋ぐ is a collocation, not a sense of 繋ぐ - the same shape as 'circle formed by people' for 輪. (Worth noting separately: the EN line 'to tie, to fasten' omits the general 'to connect, to link' sense that ZH already has as 连接.)
'thoroughness, completeness' covers 徹底する; the proposal is the verb form.
'identity, same' = 'identical or same'.
'entrance, admission' covers entering a venue.
'farmer, farm family' = 'farm household or farmer'.
'remnant, residue' is the same sense as 'remainder, leftover'; the rest of a cake reads fine.
'wish, desire' covers the hope of winning.
'opposition, resistance' covers rebelling against parents.
'offender, criminal' = 'culprit'.
'criticism, review' already contains 'review'.
A referee's 笛 is a whistle, not a flute or pipe - 'the referee blew the flute' is what the current EN line yields. ZH 笛子 is the musical instrument only, so both lists are missing it.
'garments, attire' = 'clothing or attire'.
'safety' covers arriving safely; the proposal is its adverbial form.
'in the unlikely event' already covers 万一の時に備えて (preparing for an emergency).
'comfort, ease' already covers work being easy.
